method: Scoped primary-source and citation-chain research through Hermes GPU-host GroktoCrawl; source-level text inspected; reported results not reproduced.

searches.query: TabPFN TabICL foundation tabular models limitations evaluation leakage local inference fine tuning official

sources.finding: Current README defines separate code/weight terms, version-specific APIs/defaults, first-use authentication and local checkpoint selection. Ordinary fit and gradient fine-tuning are distinct.
sources.limits: README is an operational route, not executed compatibility. Freeze actual package/checkpoint, exact terms and egress behavior.

sources.finding: Official overview explains synthetic-data pretraining and labeled-table in-context inference.
sources.limits: Vendor quality claims are not local measurements; untrusted embedded agent instructions are source content, not task authority.

sources.finding: Extracted analysis describes mixed synthetic priors and approximate posterior prediction.
sources.limits: HTML begins mid-paper; no complete-paper or causal-identification claim.

sources.finding: Actual retrieved paper is From Tables to Time: temporal featurization plus tabular regression for forecasting.
sources.limits: Initial discovery name was inaccurate; retain under actual title as forecasting orientation, not TabPFN-v2 original model paper. Abstract evidence only.

sources.finding: Actual retrieved paper analyzes TabPFN-v2 heterogeneity, feature representations and divide-and-conquer inference.
sources.limits: Wrong guessed TabICL identifier; retained as adjacent TabPFN analysis, not falsely cited as TabICL paper.

sources.finding: Author repository distinguishes original TabICL from TabICLv2 and exposes pretraining, classification/regression and caching routes.
sources.limits: README/catalog metadata is not executed runtime or verified code/weight license; benchmark numbers remain author-reported.

sources.limits: Pin actual implementation before executing; SFT/LoRA language-model scripts are not interchangeable.

sources.finding: Guessed LICENSE path returned an Entry not found page.
sources.limits: HTTP wrapper success is not retained content evidence; corrected exact LICENSE.txt path fetched.

sources.finding: Model generations have distinct local/hosted, row/feature/class/text and license limits; maximum rows and features trade off.
sources.limits: Ceilings and benchmark performance not jointly demonstrated on our hardware.

sources.limits: Independent local test and task-specific comparison absent; latest report metrics are author claims.

sources.finding: Correct original TabICL author abstract supplies its in-context architecture and scaling rationale.
sources.limits: Abstract/README evidence only; local operational integration remains not run.
